suggestions: Pre-filter a large table as a CTE before the join
Reorder joins to reduce intermediate rows
reached_sql:
WITH dw2 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        i_category,
        i_class,
        i_brand,
        i_product_name,
        d_year,
        d_qoy,
        d_moy,
        s_store_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(ss_sales_price * ss_quantity, 0)) AS sumsales,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY i_category
            ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(ss_sales_price * ss_quantity, 0)) DESC
        ) AS rk
    FROM
        store_sales
        JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
        JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
        JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
    WHERE
        d_month_seq BETWEEN 1217 AND 1217 + 11
    GROUP BY
        ROLLUP(
            i_category,
            i_class,
            i_brand,
            i_product_name,
            d_year,
            d_qoy,
            d_moy,
            s_store_id
        )
)
SELECT
    i_category,
    i_class,
    i_brand,
    i_product_name,
    d_year,
    d_qoy,
    d_moy,
    s_store_id,
    sumsales,
    rk
FROM
    dw2
WHERE
    rk <= 100
ORDER BY
    i_category,
    i_class,
    i_brand,
    i_product_name,
    d_year,
    d_qoy,
    d_moy,
    s_store_id,
    sumsales,
    rk
LIMIT 100
